The '''First Naval Fleet''' was a fleet in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==History==
[[Nova Stihl]] served in the fleet at some point and participated in a fighting tournament hosted by the fleet. He used his skills with [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] to become its [[Unarmed Middleweight Champion]] two years, as well as runner-up for two more.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

The First Fleet was known to have a large [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="EOTEB">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beta|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beta]]</ref>
